en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullahasws, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws
regarding pelting of Al-Jamarah. Heasws said to him: ‘With each pebble one pelts with, a major sins get Obliterated from him’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from Hammad from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
with every pebble that one throws on al-Jamar, one major destructive sin is deleted.”
